title: Lubbuu harka kennatte abidda qulqulluu
intro: Fuuldura kee oduu durii ija jabina addaa, kan namni dhuunfaa tokko amantii qaroomina guutuu keessatti hundee gadi fageeffate mormuuf ija jabaatee jira. Xuxxuqaawwan yeroo darbee kana hordofaa, jireenya amantii hin sochoone, dinqiidhaan lubbuun jiraachuu fi bu’uura imala hafuuraa biliyoonaan lakkaa’aman bocu kaa’uudhaan mallatteeffame ni saaxilta. Tokkoon tokkoon akeekkachiisa of eeggannoodhaan hordofaa — ibiddi qulqulluun ammallee ni yaadata.
clues: Maatii qaamolee samii kabajuu fi waaqolii tolfamoo bocuun dhaladhe, ta’us garuu wanti gadi fageenyaan na keessa jiru waan isaan waaqeffatan ni dide.
Bulchaa biyya koo isa humna guddaa qabu dura dhaabadhee, waaqolii tolfamoo sabni koo itti jilbeenfate sana caccabsee, Uumaa samii qofatu of kennuu akka qabu labse.
Maqaa kootiin ibiddi boba’u ajajame, garuu Inni ani kophaa koo tajaajilu akka na oolchu labse — abiddichi qabbanaa’aa fi nageenya akka ta’u ajajame.
Ajaja waaqaatiin waanuma barame hunda dhiisee, maatii koo wajjin gammoojjii goggogaa keessa naanna’ee, qophii ammallee arguu hin dandeenyetti amanadheen ture.
Gammoojjii gogaa tokko keessatti ilma koo isa angafaa cinaa dhaabannee, bu’uura mana qulqulluu, bakka qulqulluu warra bitamaniif murtaa’e tokkoo wajjin kaafne.
Ani Khalilullah — hiriyyaa dhiyoo rahmata godhamaa — jedhamuun beekama, maqaan koos bara baraan amantii harka kennachuu fi bitamuu wajjin walitti hidhame.

arabic: إِنِّى وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِىَ لِلَّذِى فَطَرَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ حَنِيفًۭا ۖ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
verse: Indeed, I have turned my face [i.e., self] toward He who created the heavens and the earth, inclining toward truth, and I am not of those who associate others with Allāh." (6:79)
